questions.q: What did Oprah realize when she considered taking the Broadway offer?
a: She loved the idea of it, not the reality
She was too old to learn a new script
The pay was lower than television work
She had already promised the role to a friend
questions.why: The overview says picturing the daily details made her see she could never live in New York or perform eight shows a week.

questions.q: What did Albina do at age 45 that changed her life?
a: She went back to school to train as a teacher
She moved to a new country alone
She started her own clothing business
She wrote a book about the civil war
questions.why: Lesson 1 says Albina returned to education at 45, graduated, gained financial independence and rebuilt her family life.

questions.q: What does the PANAS test measure?
a: How strongly you feel positive and negative emotions
How much money you need to feel secure
How many close friends you have in your life
How well you handle stressful situations
questions.why: Lesson 2 describes a five-minute self-assessment, the Positive and Negative Affect Schedule, that rates 20 emotions.

questions.q: Which four pillars does the summary say happiness depends on?
a: Family, friendship, work and faith
Health, wealth, love and leisure
Money, power, pleasure and prestige
Sleep, exercise, diet and purpose
questions.why: Lesson 3 names family, friendships, work and faith as the big pillars, and suggests practical ways to strengthen each.

questions.q: Which four idols does the summary warn against chasing?
a: Money, power, pleasure and prestige
Fame, beauty, comfort and approval
Status, security, routine and control
Success, wealth, travel and leisure
questions.why: Lesson 3 cites Thomas Aquinas's four idols, which people pursue when they feel out of control, instead of building the real pillars.
